result.decision_rationale: The focused gate passed on the exact candidate. The recorded reporter-stack run supports a successful Fire Beetle selection and summon, and the persistence run supports battered pricing after a fresh load with Gunslinger disabled. Final readiness still requires the simulated session’s completion evidence, a full-precision native range observer, and accurate restoration of the sorcerer probe’s incoming selection. The investigation record also conflates two different GUID-targeted experiments.

The reporter’s raw log and complete 43-mod installation were unavailable. The four-mod partial stack and injected conditions cannot identify the reporter’s failing predicate or establish that the reporter saw a menu open empty.

Donor weight is read from the serialized field for the before/after fingerprint. The effective subcategory check calls the patched engine HasSubCategory method, and production range validation reads the full Feet value.

findings.actual: The 17:14:10 command moved to the background after 600 seconds. The 17:24:20 follow-up also moved to the background without printing a result. The supplied evidence directory contains the focused gate files only. The investigation document reports 12 passing launches, but no captured completion output corroborates that result.

The completed baseline demonstrates the old failure, and the completed reporter-stack session exercises successful startup.

findings.actual: WeaponTypeProfiles.Getters still formats a returned Feet through feet.Value, which truncates 6.25 to 6. Its full-precision FieldText helper is bypassed for precisely this type. The production validator was corrected, but successful-startup and reload observations can still record a fractional reach as exactly 6.
findings.blocking_rationale: The independent observer can certify the wrong effective range, and the developer disposition specifically claims that this reader was corrected.
findings.expected: Both production diagnostics and the native profile observer retain the effective distance at full precision.
findings.requested_correction: Pass the returned Feet through the existing full-precision FieldText reader. Keep the integer comparison in OldClonePredicateFailures where it intentionally represents the old release.
findings.requested_evidence: Exercise the corrected native observer on a live getter returning 6.25 ft and show that its recorded value is 6.25. Retain the production failure control and an ordinary 6 ft observation.
findings.title: The native profile observer still truncates fractional effective reach
findings.trigger: A native profile or fresh-load observation reads a weapon type whose effective AttackRange is 6.25 ft.

findings.actual: The idle check covers targeting and open groups. Start then captures only GetSingleSelectedUnit(). Release selects that unit or the main character, and its verification checks targeting and groups only. An empty selection becomes a main-character selection, and a multi-unit selection cannot be reconstructed from one unit.
findings.blocking_rationale: The harness can report restored isolation and allow a subsequent step to run with a changed party selection. The passing non-idle targeting control covers a different incoming state.
findings.expected: After the probe changes selection, successful cleanup restores the incoming selection exactly, or the probe refuses an unsupported selection before mutation.
findings.requested_correction: Capture and verify the incoming selected units and current unit, or restrict admission to a restorable single selection and verify that selection on release. Remove the fallback that introduces a selection when none existed.
findings.requested_evidence: Use an idle disposable fixture with an empty or multi-unit selection. Show exact selection preservation after cleanup or refusal before mutation. Keep the existing pre-targeted refusal control.
findings.title: Sorcerer cleanup can replace an incoming empty or multi-unit selection
findings.trigger: The action bar is closed and targeting is idle, but the incoming party selection is empty or contains multiple units.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Register no longer calls nativeType.Weight before or after construction. The fingerprint uses m_Weight, and the donor getter read in the definitive observation is guarded. S-10 is configured to exercise the original trigger. Its execution result is covered by R3-F1.

The session supplies independent released ability and unit GUIDs. The probe checks the selected row, submitted ability, command success and spawned unit against them. The reporter-stack launch printed PASS.

The production ordering is corrected. The definitive getter check receives the registered type with its released GUID. The requested historical account still describes a different getter condition as the same experiment.

The definitive validation calls WeaponCategoryExtension.HasSubCategory for the registered category and reads that method’s patch owners on a mismatch. S-12 configures a late Finessable-removal control. Its completion evidence is covered by R3-F1.
Production reads the full effective Feet value. The native observer still explicitly uses the integer Value property and therefore misses the fractional case.
The recorded lifecycle run supports refusal with pre-existing targeting intact. An idle probe can still lose an empty or multi-unit selection and report restored isolation.

summary.delivered_behavior: The candidate explicitly configures the owned spear, validates its effective profile after GUID assignment, defers selector publication, and preserves native sale prices when startup leaves the battered token unavailable. The completed partial-stack run supports a usable Summon Monster I menu and a successful selected Fire Beetle summon. The fresh-load run supports saved battered-item ownership and pricing with Gunslinger disabled.
